subject: Asking for help on addSightings () to add count matrix of unmarked animal (Tu)

messages.author: e99a6e0ce88dcab6
messages.subject: Asking for help on addSightings () to add count matrix of unmarked animal (Tu)
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to estimate Asiatic leopard density that melanistic individuals (lack natural mark: unmarked) can contribute to about 20-30% of the population. I am thinking of applying Spatial Mark-Resight (SMR) for each survey season between 2019-2011. I believe this is sighting only data situation and total number of naturally marked animal is unknown.

I am not fully understand all steps at this point and could not add my Tu matrix into the capthist object as all codes and data attached below. I would greatly appreciate it if anyone could help review my data format and code for me.

Best regards,  
Manoon  

###########
# Set WD
###########
SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir <- paste(getwd(), "From camtrapR TowardSpatDetectionHist",
                             "03_SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir", sep="/")

###########
# READ IN TRAP DATA
###########
# I still not totally understand this section but I could get through to the bottom
SMRtrap2019Temp <- read.table(paste(SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir,
                          "SMRtrap2019withUsage.txt", sep="/"))

SMRtrap2019 <- read.traps(
                  file=paste(SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir,
                  "SMRtrap2019withUsage.txt", sep="/"),
                  detector = "proximity",
                  binary.usage = FALSE)

# Note: If binary.usage=TRUE, it will be this error message as below:
# Error in read.traps(file = paste(... : 'usage' fields suggest varying number of occasions. So I set binary.usage=FALSE and try to add usage information later

# In addition, if I apply 'markocc = c(rep(0, 2011))' at this step, I will get this error:
# Error in `markocc<-`(`*tmp*`, value = markocc) : markocc not compatible with existing usage attribute. I,  therefore, skip it for now.

# Add 'usage' to traps data, taking from the original camera table above
usage(SMRtrap2019)
usage(SMRtrap2019) <- SMRtrap2019Temp[, 4:(ncol(SMRtrap2019Temp)-1)]
usage(SMRtrap2019)

# Add covariates to camera table, taking from the original camera table above again
LocationType2019 <- SMRtrap2019Temp[, ncol(SMRtrap2019Temp)]
covariates(SMRtrap2019) <- LocationType2019
covariates(SMRtrap2019)

markocc(SMRtrap2019) <- c(rep(0, ncol(usage2019Temp)-4))
summary(SMRtrap2019)

###########
# READ IN CAPTURE DATA
###########
# Read from text file
SMRcapt2019 <- read.table(paste(SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir, "SMRcapt2019.txt", sep="/"))

# Make capture history
SMRCH2019 <- make.capthist(SMRcapt2019, SMRtrap2019)
class(SMRCH2019) # Successfull!
summary(SMRCH2019)

###########
# ADD Tu MATRIX
###########
# Read in the table
Tu2019ReadIn <- read.table(paste(SMRcaptSMRtrapTabDir, "Exported_Tu2019.txt", sep="/"))[,-1] # Drop session column here

# Then, when I apply this:
SMRCH2019withTu <- addSightings(SMRCH2019, unmarked=Tu2019ReadIn)
# This error shown:
# Error in if (!trapsOK) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
###########

messages.author: 0d55481cd93a3017
messages.subject: Re: Asking for help on addSightings () to add count matrix of unmarked animal (Tu)
parts:
Hi Manoon! I hope it's ok if I give my two-cents! I'm a new-ish user of SECR also doing sighting work, and I learnt how to deal with this particular issue a few weeks ago.

If a trap or camera are not working on a given night, this needs to be indicated in the trap layout document. This is done in the 'usage' column, which comes after the coordinates. I've attached my trap layout as an example (I had 48 nights of observations). This link has more info <https://www.otago.ac.nz/density/pdfs/secr-varyingeffort.pdf>, but you can have a binary usage (1 and 0, where 1 is working and 0 is not) or non-binary (e.g. 2, 1, 0, where 0 is not working, 1 is partial effort and 2 is greater effort, etc., but I'm not very familiar with this). Put one value for each night, separated by spaces if using a txt file (e.g. 0 0 1 1 1 for 5 nights of observations, with the camera off for the first 2 nights). This works for both mark-recapture analysis with traps, and for sighting analysis such as with cameras.

Then, in your tu and tm documents, you don't use an NA, you just put 0 for any night an individual was not seen (even if the trap/camera was not on) as the capthist already has the camera usage information from the trap layout file. (example Tu document attached)

IMPORTANT: Beware though, that under the current SECR version, usage and sightings do not work together. You'll just get NA for all your values (density, g0 etc.). You need to download and manually install the newest pre-release 4.5.4 version. You can find that here: https://groups.google.com/g/secrgroup/c/uCt0w6JzEHk

I hope that makes sense!
Cheers
Tess
